title: Proper flat geometrically reduced connected fibres have universal structure-sheaf pushforward
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. If every geometric fibre of $f$ is reduced and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], then $f_*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_S$, and this isomorphism remains true after every base change $T\to S$ [def-pc-base-change].
